messages.subject: CONGRATULATIONS! You are shortlisted - pay registration fee to confirm seat
messages.body:
Dear Candidate,

Congratulations! Based on your profile you have been PRE-SELECTED for our Data Analyst program.
To confirm your seat, please pay a REFUNDABLE registration fee of Rs 999 via UPI to secure@fastpay-verify.example within 2 hours or you will lose this opportunity.
Selection is guaranteed once payment is confirmed.

Regards,
HR Team
